Recovery.HistoryHint.zh: 选择画布恢复为副本，原工程和历史记录保持不变。
Recovery.HistoryHint.en: Restore a copy. The original project and history entry stay unchanged.

Recovery.NoHistory.zh: 还没有可恢复的历史画布。
Recovery.NoHistory.en: No workspace history is available yet.

Recovery.RestoredPassThrough.zh: 历史画布已恢复，当前为穿透模式。

Recovery.RestoredEditing.zh: 历史画布已恢复，可以继续编辑。
Recovery.RestoredEditing.en: Workspace restored. You can continue editing.

Recovery.RestoreFailed.en: Could not restore the selected workspace:

Layers.DepthPriorityOcclusionHint.zh: 实验性：按立牌锚点深度决定遮挡；同深度时按图层顺序。画布底色、网格和贴面参与遮挡。
Layers.DepthPriorityOcclusionHint.en: Experimental: order occlusion by billboard anchor depth, using layer order at equal depth. Canvas color, grid and surface layers participate.

Layers.HelpText.zh:
拖动左侧手柄调整层级；眼睛切换显示，锁切换锁定。右键可复制、删除、置顶、置底和编组。

Ctrl+D　复制所选图层
Delete　删除未锁定的所选图层
Ctrl+G　编组
Ctrl+Shift+G　解组
Esc　取消拖动；没有拖动时关闭图层面板
Layers.HelpText.en:
Drag the left handle to reorder; use the eye and lock to change visibility and locking. Right-click for duplicate, delete, ordering and grouping.

Ctrl+D  Duplicate selected layers
Delete  Delete selected unlocked layers
Ctrl+G  Group
Ctrl+Shift+G  Ungroup
Esc  Cancel a drag; otherwise close the Layers panel

Inspector.DragNumeric.zh: 左右拖动调整；Shift 精调，Ctrl 加速；Esc 取消
Inspector.DragNumeric.en: Drag left or right; Shift for precision, Ctrl for speed; Esc to cancel

Preset.InvalidLibrary.zh: 预设文件无效，原文件已保留。
Preset.InvalidLibrary.en: The preset file is invalid. The original file was kept.

Preset.InvalidName.zh: 请输入有效的预设名称。

Configuration.RepairMessage.zh:
无法读取配置文件 {0}。可能是文件内容损坏或存在重复字段。

退出可保留所有文件；选择“备份并修复配置”会先备份设置、工具状态及各预设配置，然后仅重置这个无法读取的文件。画布、工程和恢复数据不会被重置。

备份位置：{1}\configuration-backups
Configuration.RepairMessage.en:
The configuration file {0} could not be read. It may contain damaged content or duplicate fields.

Exit to keep all files. Backup and repair first copies settings, tool state and preset configuration, then resets only this unreadable file. Canvas, project and recovery data are retained.

Backup location: {1}\configuration-backups

Configuration.SaveCancelled.zh: 已取消保存兼容性修复，原配置文件保持不变。
Configuration.SaveCancelled.en: Compatibility repair was cancelled. The original configuration file was retained.

Color.InvalidHex.zh: 请输入 #RGB、#RRGGBB 或 #AARRGGBB 色值。

Color.InvalidLibrary.zh: 颜色文件无效，原文件已保留。
Color.InvalidLibrary.en: The color file is invalid. The original file was kept.

Stamp.LibraryHint.zh: 保存、整理并复用图案；将常用印章固定到十格快捷栏。
Stamp.LibraryHint.en: Save and organize reusable artwork. Pin frequent stamps to the ten-slot shelf.

Stamp.EditableGroup.zh: 可编辑组合：保留文字、矢量和子元素
Stamp.EditableGroup.en: Editable group: preserve text, vectors and children

Stamp.RasterMerge.zh: 合并为图片：保留源工程，可另行编辑
Stamp.RasterMerge.en: Merge as image: retain the source project for editing

Stamp.OperationFailed.en: Could not complete the stamp operation:

Stamp.NoSelection.zh: 请先选择要保存的元素。

Stamp.Corrupt.en: Stamp resources are missing or corrupt:

Stamp.InvalidLibrary.zh: 印章库索引无法读取，原文件已保留：
Stamp.InvalidLibrary.en: Cannot read the stamp library; original files are preserved:

Stamp.Missing.zh: 印章不存在或已被删除。
Stamp.Missing.en: The stamp does not exist or has been deleted.

Stamp.EmptyName.zh: 名称须包含 1–120 个字符。

ToolOptions.NoParameters.zh: 当前工具没有可调整的绘制参数。
ToolOptions.NoParameters.en: This tool has no drawing parameters.

ToolOptions.InvalidNumber.zh: 请输入范围内的有效数值。
ToolOptions.InvalidNumber.en: Enter a valid number within the allowed range.

ToolbarV2.LauncherHint.zh: 单击或右键打开菜单 · 双击显示或隐藏画布 · 拖动移动工具条 · Tab 展开或收起工具条
ToolbarV2.LauncherHint.en: Click or right-click for menu · Double-click to show or hide the canvas · Drag to move · Tab to expand or collapse the toolbar

Effect.RegionFrozen.zh: 已冻结选区并添加效果；可以继续移动和编辑。
Effect.RegionFrozen.en: Region frozen with effect; move and edit it as an image.

Color.SampleHint.zh: 单击画布取色，Esc 取消。
Color.SampleHint.en: Click the canvas to sample a color; Esc cancels.
